watchOS 27.2 will be released next month, bringing multiple new Apple Watch features. Leaker pdfu has also recently discovered major changes to the screenshot function.

watchOS 27.2 code contains a new screenshot experience that mimics the iPhone

Leaker pdfu has recently begun sharing multiple details discovered from Apple code. For example, he was the first to discover the Readiness app in watchOS 27, and yesterday he also leaked the HomePod Siri AI interface.

In a new article today, pdfu revealed that watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a completely redesigned Apple Watch screenshot experience.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch only causes the screen to flash, then the screenshot is saved to your photo library.

The new screenshot operation workflow mimics the current approach on iPhone and iPad, letting you choose to immediately share or delete the screenshot.

It remains unclear whether Apple plans to implement this change in the upcoming watchOS 27.2 beta, or whether it still needs more time for development. However, even if it ultimately cannot make it into watchOS 27.2, Apple Watch will very likely welcome this feature in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked from watchOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments section.
